messages:
Olivia M: Kicking off the phased geozone rollout for release v2.1.2 — sequence will be US -> EU -> APAC. Change window 03:00-06:00 UTC. Pin v2.1.2 to traffic in canary slices only. Please confirm capacity + any blockers.

deploy-bot: Starting canary: region=us-west1 slice=alpha variant=v2.1.2 canary_pct=2%. Logs: https://ci.redwood/logs/2175001234-canary

Matt R: Confirming. Will pin fallback to v2.1.1 for immediate rollback. Command: `rdctl rollout pin --region us-west1 --fallback v2.1.1`

Sara K: Capacity quick check: us-west1 GPUs healthy. Available: 18/24 (75%), avg token QPS within expected. EU quota also warmed (16/20, 80%) but no warm pool in apac yet.

Yun Li: Heads up — customer-managed KMS key for EU private tenants rotates at 04:15 UTC. If rotation hits during EU cutover we should postpone or ensure key caching.

Kevin P: Suggest add soft-threshold: if error-rate > 1.5% or P95 latency > 350ms in canary for 10m -> hold rollout and notify oncall.

deploy-bot: Canary health update (10m): error_rate=0.4% p95=210ms request_rate=120r/s. No anomalies.

Olivia M: Good. Matt, pin config in the release manifest for automatic fallback. Also set region-routing policy: prefer-latency -> us -> eu -> apac.

Matt R: Done. Manifest snippet: 
```
- region_policy: [us, eu, apac]
- fallback_variant: v2.1.1
- hold_conditions:
  - error_rate > 1.5% for 10m
  - p95 > 350ms for 10m
```

Sara K: EU warmup plan: spin +2 nodes in eu-central at T+20m, run smoke load for 5m. APAC: recommend delaying warmup until EU passes 30% traffic to avoid over-commit.

Yun Li: For private customers in EU, ops will defer their cutover by 30m to cover KMS rotation. I'll post the list of tenants affected.

Kevin P: If EU hits 70% GPU utilization during its ramp, throttle traffic back to 20% and escalate to infra. Add an auto-backoff rule.

deploy-bot: EU canary start queued. Expected start: 2175002434. Will report health at 5m and 15m intervals.

Olivia M: Agreed on auto-backoff. Add annotation to the rollout: `auto_backoff: {util_pct: 70, reduce_to: 20}`. Also capture release notes: feature toggles, quantization profile update, and known non-blocking eval delta +0.3 BLEU.

Matt R: Release notes pushed to changelog and docs. I also added an emergency rollback playbook link: https://confluence.redwood/release-rollback-playbook

Sara K: Quick FYI — APAC warm pool capacity: 0/8 warmed. We can borrow spare from us-east if needed but latency will be impacted. Recommend keeping APAC at minimal traffic until warmed.

deploy-bot: US canary steady at 2% for 30m. health: ok. EU queued start at 2175002434. APAC will remain deferred.

Olivia M: Final check: oncall notified? @Kevin P @Yun Li please ack. If no objections, proceed with EU canary at scheduled start and hold APAC until explicit go.

Kevin P: Ack. I'll monitor infra dashboards and ready to throttle. :thumbsup:

Yun Li: Ack. I'll post affected private-tenants list in #customer-success and delay their cutovers.

Olivia M: Thanks team. Keep this thread for updates. If we hit hold conditions, call the rollback playbook and notify sales/CS immediately.

deploy-bot: EU canary health @5m: error_rate=0.9% p95=260ms util=64% — continuing. APAC still deferred.

Olivia M: Nice. Leave APAC pinned to manual until we have warm pool and verified KMS window clear.

Sara K: I'll start APAC warmup once EU is stable for 30m. Posting follow-up when warm nodes are available.

Matt R: Noted. Will keep fallback ready and watch the canary metrics.

deploy-bot: Thread closed for new canary events until next scheduled health interval. Logs archived: https://ci.redwood/logs/2175001234-archive
